messages:
kai: quick design question — we're deciding how granular service keys should be for routing/quotas/telemetry. option A = route by key -> project/sa -> dedicated pool. option B = route by route config + fallback to key. which gives us best telemetry and least console surprise?

maya: my take: route by token (project+SA) is clearer for billing/quotas. clients already expect their SA to isolate usage. fallback to org key only when explicitly allowed. telemetry needs a clear 'attribution' field.

sophia: +1 to token-based routing but two asks: 1) how do we handle rotated/ephemeral keys? 2) can we reuse auth-proxy claims so runtime doesn't parse tokens for every request? eg `authz.claims.project_id` and `authz.claims.service_account`

marcus: telemetry naming proposal: emit `inference.request.attributed_to:{sa|project|org}` and `inference.routing.path:{dedicated|shared|fallback}`. sample 0.1% debug traces with full header dump for early rollout. alerts if `attributed_to==org` spikes.

olivia: quota enforcement question: if SA has quota X and org has Y, which wins? I'd prefer stricter (min(SA,project,org)) for fast fail; fallback routing should never bypass quota checks. also UX note: console needs a single line that says "effective quota" and breakdown by source.

kai: good points. rollout idea: start with passive routing (no enforced failover) for 1% of traffic, collect metrics above, then opt-in canary for teams. console flag per-org -> `auth.routing.strict` toggle. example config: ```yaml
canary: 0.01
strict: false
attribution_signal: authz.claims.project_id
```

sophia: about ephemeral tokens — we should map ephemeral -> parent SA via `parent_sa` claim and attribute to parent. rotation is fine as long as `kid` -> `parent_sa` mapping is in our authz cache. add cache eviction and metric `auth.token.mapper.cache_miss`.

marcus: ops/alerts: add dashboard tiles: 1) perc of requests by `attributed_to`, 2) fallback rate (requests routed to fallback pool), 3) token-mapper cache hit rate. set pager if fallback rate > 0.5% for >10m.

maya: console UX copy: "Requests attributed to this SA" and a button "Force attribution to org" (admin only). Also show recent attribution mismatches with sample traces. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: auth-token-mapper v2 -> staging. CI job 7845. status: queued.

kai: action items: 1) marcus to sketch metrics + alerts, 2) sophia to spec token->parent mapping and cache TTLs, 3) olivia + maya to design console panel + copy, 4) i'll draft rollout canary flag and RBAC guard. i'll open a PR with config schema. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maya: cool — can we add a telemetry dimension `auth.source` with values `token|proxy|api-key` so we can filter support tickets?

kai: yep will include that.

olivia: one more — if quota denial happens, response should be 429 with `x-auth-attribution` header telling which quota enforced. saves support churn.

kai: agreed. add to spec.

marcus: will add tests for metric emission and a small harness that replays requests with rotated keys.

kai: thanks — i'll follow up with PR link and we'll schedule a short sync tomorrow.
